scope: General blood-test education only, with the report's applicable laboratory interval. No pediatric, pregnancy-specific, disease-management or assay-specific targets.
overview: Platelet counts and platelet function tests measure different aspects of clotting.
high: Infection, inflammation, anemia or blood loss can be associated with increased counts.
low: Viral infection, immune conditions or marrow problems can be associated with decreased counts.
caveats: A count is not a platelet-function test and cannot independently establish bleeding or clotting risk.
